messages: it wasn't me it was the one armed man
I just spent 4 minutes staring at my fridge expecting new food to magically spawn in it. How’s your day going?
Bought vegetables with the best of intentions, but we both know they’re just going to turn into green liquid in the crisp drawer while I order takeout.
My brain at 3 PM: fully exhausted, could sleep anywhere. My brain at 11:30 PM: let's rewatch every embarrassing moment from 2018.
I’m not running late, I’m just giving everyone else a head start to keep things fair.
Nothing makes you feel like an absolute child quite like having to make your own doctor's appointment.
We need to hang out soon so we can sit on the same couch in total silence while both scrolling on our phones.
